title: [MR-002] Serve authorized run status and original handoffs from a local Vibez host
objective: Serve authorized run state and exact current correspondence for one configured Vibez checkout.
inScope: Implement the opt-in loopback-only read host and v1 pairing, capability discovery, run listing and status detail.
Project native sessions and eligible current correspondence through scoped opaque IDs. Supply installed operator instructions and HTTP/CLI parity, immutable read and denial tests.
outOfScope: Browser work, workflow commands, historical packet access, live Developer-to-QA acceptance, new task admission, and browser publication or merge.
acceptanceCriteria: MR-002.1: In a clean installed consumer, inspect a real CLI-started run over HTTP and return the exact current role or repair correspondence bytes. Repeated status/list/copy observations leave native gates and handoffs untouched.

MR-002.2: Enforce loopback listener, exact Host and browser origin, expiring operator pairing, scoped project/profile/session and bound packet identity, request/response limits and safe artifact resolution.
MR-002.3: Distinguish missing, offline, unsupported, prepared and blocked states. Advertise only enabled read capabilities and expose known gate, revision and PR/CI provenance without guessing.
validationPlan: Run the Vibez README checks and the packaged independent HTTP client test against a disposable native CLI-started run.
Check v1 schema conformance, native state immutability, cross-project/session and untrusted origin denial, safe artifact resolution, exact Markdown and listener-stop CLI compatibility.
